140.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman in left profile. The left hand rests on the seat's frame. A pink rose fastened to the chest of a white blouse. A white headdress fastened under the chin with a velvet ribbon.

141.d: Esiplaanil kurruline maastik suurte kivide ja rändrahnudega. Taamal maja ja metsa kontuur.
141.de: In the foreground a rugged landscape with large stones and boulders. In the distance a house and the outline of a forest.

142.d: Ees paremal eest taha mäkke suunduva tee ääres telefonipostide rida. Vasakul üle oru sild ja teelahk. Taga vasakul (ülal mäe künkal) punane gooti stiilis kirik - keskel ja paremal majad.
142.de: In the front on the right, along a road leading from the foreground into the hill, a row of telephone poles. On the left a bridge over a valley and a fork in the road. In the back on the left (up on a hillock) a red Gothic-style church - in the centre and on the right houses.

145.d: Valge rüüžiga pluusi riietatud naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Parema kõrva kohal juustes punane roos.
145.de: Chest portrait of a woman dressed in a blouse with white ruche, in half-profile to the right. A red rose in the hair above the right ear.

147.d: Pikkade, rinnale langevate juustega, murumütsis mehe figuur koobastikus. Mehel seljas pikk pükste peale tõmmatud särk, jalas pastlad. Vasakus, ülestõstetud käes kelluke. Mehe ees, vasakul, maas hiireke.
147.de: A figure of a man with long hair falling to his chest, wearing a grass cap, in a cave system. The man wears a long shirt pulled over his trousers, and bast shoes on his feet. In his raised left hand a bell. In front of the man, on the left, a little mouse on the ground.

148.d: Veekogu keskel suur kivi. Sellel lamav naisakt, käed laiali, tagaplaanil vees kivid.
148.de: A large rock in the middle of a body of water. On it a reclining female nude, arms spread, rocks in the water in the background.

149.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand laudu kandva tugeva mehe kujuga. Tagaplaanil lainetav veteväli.
149.de: In the foreground a stony shore with the figure of a strong man carrying boards. In the background a wavy expanse of water.

150.d: Kühmulisel maastikul vasakult paremale sammuva naise kuju kiviga süles. Tagaplaanil üle laia veepinna silmapiirile laskuv päike ehatamas.
150.de: In a hilly landscape, the figure of a woman walking from left to right with a stone in her lap. In the background, the sun setting in the evening glow over a wide expanse of water.

151.d: Fantastiline kompositsioon naise ja mehe figuuridega.
151.de: Fantastical composition with figures of a woman and a man.

152.d: Keskel "Linda Libeneitsi": reel istuv talumees, rahvarõivais tütarlapsega põlvedel.
152.de: In the middle "Linda Libeneits": a farmer sitting on a sledge with a girl in folk costume on his knees.

153.d: Pildi keskel neli üksteise embuses kiires tantsuhoos keerlevat paari. Meesfiguurid tumesinistes ülikondades, naised pikkades kollakas-pruunides kleitides, mille voldistik sulab kokku pruunikates toonides fooniga.
153.de: In the centre of the picture, four couples embracing one another, whirling in a swift dance. The male figures in dark blue suits, the women in long yellowish-brown dresses, whose folds merge with the background in brownish tones.

155.d: Roigasaed, taga erkroheline rohumaa, mille ääres madal, õlgkatusega talumaja. Katuse kohal, paremal puude kirevad lehekroonid.
155.de: A picket fence, behind it bright green grassland, at its edge a low farmhouse with a thatched roof. Above the roof, on the right, the colourful crowns of trees.

156.d: Haritorniga kirikuhoone, samas juures kasvavate suurte puude ning madala kiviaiaga. All vasakus servas teeb väikese kaare kiriku juurde viiv tee. Koloriidis ülekaalus sinised värvivarjundid.
156.de: A church building with a bell tower, with large trees growing beside it and a low stone wall. In the lower left corner the road leading to the church makes a small curve. Blue colour shades predominate.

157.d: Keskel sinises rõivastuses istuv mehefiguur (Kalevipoeg), ümber vasaku käsivarre ussikujuline võru. Vasakul odaga mees, asetamas istujale pähe murumütsi taolist peakatet. Paremal mehefiguur saunakibu ja vihaga. Taustaks talumaja. Koloriit tume; kontuurid rõhutatud.
157.de: In the centre a seated male figure dressed in blue (Kalevipoeg), a snake-shaped ring around his left forearm. On the left a man with a spear, placing a grass-cap-like headgear on the seated figure's head. On the right a male figure with a bathhouse whisk and switch. Background a farmhouse. Colouring dark; contours emphasised.

158.d: Paremal ettepoole sammuv sõdalaste malev. Meestel vasakus käes peremärke kandvad kilbid, paremas odad (eessammuval figuuril paljastatud mõõk). Tagaplaanil, künkal linnus. All punane tekstiriba: MAAMEESTE MALEWA, mille alguses ning lõpus kirve kujutised. Koloriit tume; kontuurid rõhutatud.
158.de: A troop of warriors marching forward to the right. The men hold shields bearing family marks in their left hands, and spears in their right (the leading figure has a bared sword). In the background, a fortress on a hill. Below, a red text band: MAAMEESTE MALEWA, with images of axes at its beginning and end. The colour scheme is dark; the contours are emphasised.

159.d: Punasel foonil ringis neli embavat paari. Esiplaanil, vasakpoolse paari meesfiguuril peaks kolp; naise nägu kätega kaetud.
159.de: Four embracing couples in a circle on a red background. In the foreground, the male figure of the left couple has a skull for a head; the woman's face is covered with her hands.

160.d: Mere kaldal valges särgis ning tumesinistes lühikestes pükstes peapeal seisev mees. Ümber parema käsivarre ussikujuline võru. Mere kohal lendamas kajakad. All servas keskel kitsal punasel ribal tekst: Kalevipoeg.II.714-727
160.de: On the seashore, a man in a white shirt and dark-blue short trousers standing on his head. Around his right arm a snake-shaped bracelet. Gulls flying above the sea. At the bottom edge, in the centre, on a narrow red strip, the text: Kalevipoeg.II.714-727

161.d: Sammaldunud rookatusega ait. Selle avatud ukse juures, räästa all paremal suur riidekirst; vasakul punane tekk jmt. Paremal, aida taga puud.
161.de: Mossy thatched-roof barn. By its open door, under the eaves on the right a large clothing chest; on the left a red blanket etc. On the right, behind the barn, trees.

162.d: Laineid meenutaval sinisel taustal keskel horisontaalselt paigutatud selili lamav naisakt. Pea pööratud küljele, vaatajale, pilk suunatud alla. Vasaku kõverdatud käsi kuklal, parem sirutatult küljel õlakõrgusel. Vasak jalg tõstetud üle parema. Akt maalitud beežikashallides toonides tumeda kontuuriga väliseid piirjooni rõhutades.
162.de: On a blue background reminiscent of waves, a female nude lying on her back is placed horizontally in the middle. Head turned to the side, towards the viewer, gaze directed downward. Left bent arm behind the head, right stretched out at the side at shoulder height. Left leg raised over the right. The nude is painted in beigish-grey tones with a dark contour emphasizing the outer outlines.

341.d: Tumedas kleidis vanema naise rinnaportree tugevas pöördes paremale. Juuksed ja nägu vormitud tugevate eredavärviliste tahkude kombinatsioonina. Samamoodi maalitud käed rinnal vaheliti.Foon roheliste, pruunide ja tumesiniste laikude põiming.
341.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a dark dress, strongly turned to the right. Hair and face formed as a combination of strong, brightly coloured facets. Hands likewise painted, placed alternately on the chest. Background a weave of green, brown and dark blue patches.

342.d: Tasane maastik, vasakul servas silmapiiri poole suunduv tee, teest vasakul männimetsa tukk. Silmapiiril keskel üksikud puud, paremal servas metsaviirg. Sinises taevas lopsakad valged pilved. Maalitud kontrastseid värvilaike kõrvuti asetades.
342.de: A flat landscape, with a road heading toward the horizon at the left edge, a stand of pine forest to the left of the road. Solitary trees at the centre of the horizon, a strip of forest at the right edge. Lush white clouds in a blue sky. Painted by placing contrasting patches of colour side by side.

344.d: Selgeid värvilaike moodustavate pikkade pintslilöökidega maalitud talumaastik: vasakul kaks madalat talumaja, paremal madal maja ja teivasaed. Pildi sügavuses keskel suurte kroonidega puud. Selgelt eristatavate värvilaikude kompositsioon jätab peaaegu abstraktse kogumulje, objektid eristuvad vaevu.
344.de: A farm landscape painted with long brushstrokes forming distinct patches of colour: on the left two low farmhouses, on the right a low house and a stake fence. In the depth of the picture, in the middle, trees with large crowns. The composition of clearly distinguishable colour patches leaves an almost abstract overall impression, the objects are barely distinguishable.

345.d: Roosadest, hallidest ja rohelistest pintslitõmmetest koosnev agulivaade. Vasakul matsaka puumaja otsasein, mille vasakpoolne otsaaken luugiga kaetud. Paremal pildi servaga läbilõigatud majanurk rippsildiga, millele on saabas maalitud. Maja nurga juures mees, seljaga vaataja poole. Taamal paremal roheline puudemassiiv, ülal sinine, helehallide pilvedega taevas.
345.de: An urban outskirts view composed of pink, grey and green brushstrokes. On the left, the gable end of a squat wooden house, its left-side gable window covered with a shutter. On the right, a house corner cut off by the picture's edge, with a hanging sign painted with a boot. Near the corner of the house, a man with his back to the viewer. In the background on the right, a green mass of trees, above a blue sky with light grey clouds.

1904.de: Bust portrait of a boy, long hair, wearing a fur cap, collar of a Russian shirt.

1917.dm: kõrgus: 63.0 cm; sügavus: 27.5 cm; laius: 46.0 cm
1917.d: Keskealise mehe rindportree soklil. Tsiviilriietus, habe, vurrud.
1917.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man on a pedestal. Civilian clothing, beard, moustache.

2001.d: Noore ruugejuukselise naise rinnapilt otsevaates - keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Pikad juuksed koondatud kohevil soengus kõrvu vabaks jätvalt ülesse. Õhulisest materjalist heledat tooni kleidi sügava väljalõikega sallkaelus eest lõdvas sõlmes.
2001.de: Bust portrait of a young reddish-haired woman in frontal view - body slightly turned to the left. Long hair gathered up in a fluffed-up hairstyle leaving the ears bare. A light-coloured dress of airy material with a deep scarf-collar neckline, loosely knotted in front.

2005.d: Kiilaspäise, hallide vurrudega vanemas eas mehe põlvportree istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis vasakule. Vasak käsi nõjatub tooli külgtoele kusjuures sõrmed puudutavad reit, parem käsi hoiab kinni tooli külgtoest. Riietuseks tume pintsakülikond ja tärgeldatud püstkrae ja kätistega särk. Taust punast tooni; vasakul ülal perekonna vapi kujutis - lõvi kõveral mõõgal - selle kõrval pealkiri "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"
2005.de: Knee-length portrait of an elderly bald man with grey moustaches, seated, in three-quarter profile to the left. The left hand rests on the side support of the chair, with the fingers touching the thigh, the right hand holds onto the side support of the chair. Dressed in a dark suit jacket and a shirt with a starched stand-up collar and cuffs. The background is a red tone; at upper left, a depiction of the family coat of arms - a lion on a curved sword - next to it the title "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"

2006.d: Heledate, rinnale langevate lahtiste juustega tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis. Kätega toetub istme seljatoele. Seljas hall rohekas riietus.
2006.de: Half-figure of a girl with light, loose hair falling to the chest, in a sitting position. Supporting herself with her hands on the back of the seat. Wearing greyish-green clothing.

2007.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur seistes parem külg vaataja poole, pea pööratud otse. Kõrvade juures lahtiseid juuksekiharaid, taga patsikene musta paelaga. Hallikas-sinine kinnise kraega riietus.
2007.de: Half-figure of a girl, seated, right side towards the viewer, head turned straight ahead. Loose curls of hair near the ears, a small braid behind tied with a black ribbon. Grayish-blue clothing with a closed collar.

2019.d: Pikkade juuste ja lopsaka habemega vanema mehe rindportree. Pea kolmveerand pöördes paremale. Peas must müts. Seljas tumepunane riietus.
2019.de: Chest portrait of an older man with long hair and a bushy beard. Head turned three-quarters to the right. Black cap on his head. Dark red clothing.

2022.d: Esiplaanil kaseoksa küljes rippuv häll lapsega. Tagapool kaskedega piiratud lagendikul naine riisumas.
2022.de: In the foreground a cradle with a child hanging from a birch branch. Beyond, on a clearing bordered by birches, a woman raking.

2031.dm: kõrgus: 39.0 cm; laius: 30.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 39.7 cm; laius: 30.0 cm (km)
2031.d: Kukla taha kammitud juustega, ümara näoga keskealise naise rinnaportree. Näojooned pehmed; seljas V-kujulise kaelusega tume kleit.
2031.de: A bust portrait of a middle-aged woman with a round face, hair combed back. Soft facial features; wearing a dark dress with a V-shaped neckline.

2035.d: Mustas, sulgedega kübaras keskealise pehmete näojoontega naise rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Ülal servas vasakul kiri: M.N. 138
2035.de: Bust portrait, in half-turn to the right, of a middle-aged woman with soft facial features, in a black feathered hat. In the upper left corner, an inscription: M.N. 138

2036.d: Mustjaspruunide, kuklale seotud kergelt lainetavate juutsega musta riietatud naise profiilportree paremale. Juustes pärlinöör. Sirge, veidi ülespidine nina. Tume hallikasroheline foon.
2036.de: Profile portrait facing right of a woman dressed in black, with dark brown, slightly wavy hair tied at the nape. A string of pearls in her hair. A straight, slightly upturned nose. Dark greyish-green background.

2037.d: Heledate hallikaspruunide, kuklale seotud juustega rohelisse riietatud naise poolprofiilportree paremale, pea kallutatud paremale, langetatud pilguga. Lühike nina, punased lopsakad põsed, terav lõug. Hall taust.

2038.d: Hallikate, kuklale seotud juustega musta riietatud naise poolprofiilportree paremale, ülestõstetud pilguga. Püstise laubaga ja kitsa näo etteulatuva alaosaga, terava ninaga, suurte silmadega. Pruunikaspunane foon.

2044.d: Hallides toonides foonil pruunis ümaras vaasis kimp sireleid. Vaasi all tumesinine, - punaste laikudega riie. Vaasil suur ovaalne sinine laik.
2044.de: Against a background in grey tones, a bunch of lilacs in a round brown vase. Under the vase a dark blue cloth with red spots. On the vase a large oval blue spot.

2049.d: Esiplaanil kasetüvi, vasakul oksa küljes ripub punutud häll. Selles istukile tõusnud valges särgis laps veerandpöördes paremale, vaatab ja naeratab oksal istuvale kirjule linnule. Tagapool lagendikul heina riisuv noor naine poolkummargil, pilk pööratud linnule. Naisel seljas valge pluus ja peakate, pikitriibuline seelik. Taamal, heleda, üksikute pilvedega taeva all lagendikku piiravad käharad puud. Maal pastelses rohekas koloriidis, värvikiht õhuke.
2049.de: In the foreground, a birch trunk, on the left a woven cradle hangs from a branch. In it, a child in a white shirt, having risen to a sitting position, turned a quarter to the right, looks and smiles at a mottled bird sitting on the branch. Further back in the clearing, a young woman raking hay, bent halfway over, her gaze turned toward the bird. The woman wears a white blouse and a headscarf, a longitudinally striped skirt. In the distance, under a light sky with isolated clouds, curly trees border the clearing. The painting is in a pastel greenish colouring, the paint layer thin.

2070.d: Ees vasakul rannariba maasse taotud pikkade vaiadega. Tagapool, vasakul, merre tungiv maanina üksiku männiga. Horisondil kollane viirg.
2070.de: In the front left a strip of shore with long stakes driven into the ground. Further back, on the left, a headland extending into the sea with a solitary pine. On the horizon a yellow strip.

2071.d: Istuva vana naise poolfiguur väikses püüdega paremale. Tumedas kleidis. Käed ristamisi süles.
2071.de: Half-figure of a seated old woman, small, striving to the right. In a dark dress. Hands crossed in her lap.

2072.d: Eest vasakult taha paremale suunduv tee kiviaiaga ja üksikute raagus puudega vasakul. Paremal ja vasakul tee ääres sulamata lume laike. Vasakul, kiviaia taga väike õlgkatusega hoone. Horisondil mets.
2072.de: A road leading from the front left to the back right, with a stone wall and single bare trees on the left. On the right and left along the road, patches of unmelted snow. On the left, behind the stone wall, a small building with a thatched roof. Forest on the horizon.

2074.d: Esiplaanil lagendiku keskel reas neli puud, taamal aed, hooned. Horisondil mets.
2074.de: In the foreground, in the middle of a clearing, four trees in a row, further back a garden, buildings. Forest on the horizon.

2075.d: Pikajuukselise vana mehe rinnapilt en face. Valge lühike lõuahabe, kaabu peas.
2075.de: Bust of a long-haired old man en face. White short chin beard, wearing a hat.

2077.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm (arm); laius: 32.4 cm (vm); kõrgus: 26.3 cm (vm); laius: 33.3 cm (arm)
2077.d: Ees heinamaa küüniga paremal. Taga metsatukad, millede taga veekogu. Taamal metsaviir.
2077.de: In front a meadow with a barn on the right. Behind, patches of forest, beyond which a body of water. In the distance a forest edge.

2080.d: Esiplaanil küpressid. Kaugemal järsud, kõrged mäed. Keskel oleva kõige kaugema mäe tipp kaetud igilumega.
2080.de: Cypresses in the foreground. Steep, high mountains in the distance. The peak of the farthest mountain in the middle is covered with eternal snow.

2085.d: Paremal järsk merre tungiv klajumassiiv. Taamal paremal ja vasakul sügavalt merre ulatuvad kaljusiluetid.
2085.de: On the right a steep cliff massif jutting into the sea. In the background, on the right and left, rock silhouettes reaching deep into the sea.

2086.d: Maastik vasakule mäkke tõusva teega. Esiplaanil kaks puud, taamal hooned.
2086.de: A landscape with a road rising to a hill on the left. In the foreground two trees, in the distance buildings.

2087.d: Esiplaanil paremal kõrgendik üksiku suure puuga. Taamal hoonied ja vaade merele.
2087.de: In the foreground on the right an elevation with a solitary large tree. Further back buildings and a view of the sea.

2088.d: Esiplaanil tänaval kaks inimfiguuri, ümberringi kõrged ehitiste müürid
2088.de: In the foreground on the street two human figures, surrounded by tall building walls

2089.d: Esiplaanil lauskmaal üksikuid puid ja teid. Taamal tõusval künkal siniseid täppe ja laigukesi.

2093.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannajoon, keskel avar veteväli, ankrus oleva purjepaadiga. Taamal silmapiiril sinetav saare kontuur.
2093.de: In the foreground a stony shoreline, in the middle an open expanse of water with an anchored sailboat. In the distance on the horizon the bluish outline of an island.

2097.d: Ees (ca pool lõuendist) kõrgendik suurte kivide ja üksikute põõsastega. Kõrgendiku taga madalamal alal, vasakul punase katusega gooti maakirik, paremal põldude riba ja taamal metsa veeres üksikud hooned.
2097.de: In front (about half the canvas) a rise with large stones and single bushes. Behind the rise, on lower ground, on the left a Gothic country church with a red roof, on the right a strip of fields and, further away, single buildings at the forest's edge.

2101.d: Vasakul varemed. Selle taga tõusval mäeküljel puid. Paremal madalikul järv. Taamal vaade põldudele.
2101.de: On the left, ruins. Behind them, trees on a rising hillside. On the right, in the lowland, a lake. In the distance a view of fields.

2103.d: Esiplaanil kivid ja põõsad, taamal puude vahel valged hooned. Taustaks mets.
2103.de: In the foreground stones and bushes, further off white buildings among trees. Forest as background.

2105.d: Noore naise pea profiilis vasakule. Peas kuklatagant sõlmitud sinist tooni rätt.
2105.de: Head of a young woman in profile facing left. Wearing a bluish-toned scarf tied at the back of the neck.

2108.d: Künklikul maastikul kolm sinist veeloiku; tsagapool üksikud põõsad ja puude grupid.
2108.de: Three blue puddles on a hilly landscape; on the left side single bushes and groups of trees.

2109.d: Esiplaanil maas kägaras istuva naise kuju, must-valge linikuga üle pea. Kummaski ääres lehtpuid. Keskel valgeid lilleõisi.
2109.de: In the foreground the figure of a woman sitting huddled on the ground, with a black-and-white cloth over her head. Deciduous trees on either side. White flower blossoms in the middle.

2111.d: Esiplaanil sügav sinine järv, kaldanõlvakuil suuri puid, paremal põlluriba. Taevas rahutult pilvine. Koloriit rohekas-sinine.
2111.de: In the foreground a deep blue lake, large trees on the sloping banks, a strip of field on the right. Restlessly cloudy sky. Greenish-blue colouring.

2112.d: Keskel väike veekogu, ümber põllud, nõlvadel taamal mets, taevas lapiline. Eredad värvid: sinine, kollane, roosa.

2117.d: Ees vasakul kollakas-punaseis ja paremal rohekais toonides puudegrupid. Kaugemal keskel paistab kiriku torn ja punase katusega maja. Taevas pilvine.
2117.de: In front, on the left, groups of trees in yellowish-red tones and on the right in greenish tones. Further away in the middle a church tower and a house with a red roof are visible. The sky is cloudy.

2118.d: Noore naise portree profiilis vasakule sinakal foonil. Pruunid juuksed, heleroheline peakate. Seljas punane mantel tumeda kraega.
2118.de: Portrait of a young woman in profile to the left against a bluish background. Brown hair, light green headwear. Wearing a red coat with a dark collar.

2119.dm: kõrgus: 66.2 cm; laius: 84.0 cm; kõrgus: 75.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 93.5 cm (raamiga)
2119.d: Esiplaanil meri ja kaljune kallas paremal. Kaugemal valge tuletorn, mis peegeldub vees ja mõned majad.
2119.de: In the foreground the sea and a rocky shore on the right. Further away a white lighthouse, which is reflected in the water, and some houses.

2120.d: Kupliline panoraam sügisesel päiksepaistelisel päeval. Keskplaanil lopsakaid kollastes ja punastes toonides lehtpuid, millede vahelt paistavad talumajad. Paremal lookleb ülespoole tee, alla vasakule jääb väike veekogu. Taga tumedad metsad.
2120.de: A domed panorama on a sunny autumn day. In the middle ground lush deciduous trees in yellow and red tones, between which farmhouses can be seen. On the right a road winds upward, at the lower left a small body of water. Dark forests behind.

2121.d: Vasakul järv, paremal puid, teekäänak. Domineerivad sinakas-rohelised tumedad toonid, vormikäsitlus nurgeline. Suurt tähelepanu pööratud taeva maalimisele.
2121.de: On the left a lake, on the right trees, a bend in the road. Dark bluish-green tones dominate, the treatment of form is angular. Great attention has been paid to painting the sky.

2123.d: Künkliku maastiku esiplaan kaetud roosakas-lillakate laikudega, mis maalitud lühikeste pintslilüketega, nende vahel ükskuid rohelisi põõsaid; tagapool vasakul sinakas mets, paremal põllulapid. Taevas pilverünkaid. Maal lõpetamata.
2123.de: The foreground of a hilly landscape covered with pinkish-purple patches painted with short brush strokes, with individual green bushes among them; behind on the left a bluish forest, on the right patches of fields. Cumulus clouds in the sky. The painting is unfinished.

2124.d: Suurte tumedate silmadega, valges kleidis tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur, vasak käsi puusas. Tumedates juustes kollased lilled.
2124.de: Three-quarter figure of a girl in a white dress with large dark eyes, left hand on hip. Yellow flowers in her dark hair.

2126.d: Sügavsinine järv, väikeste lehtpuudega kaetud saarekestega. Esiplaanil poolsaar. Pilvine, rahutu taevas sinakates ja lillakates toonides.

2127.d: Heledates punakates ja kollakates toonides avar künklik maastik puudegruppidega esi- ja keskplaanil.
2127.de: In light reddish and yellowish tones a spacious hilly landscape with groups of trees in the foreground and middle ground.

2128.d: Esiplaanil suured kirjud kivid, paremal kuusk. Eemal kaks õlgkatusega maja, vasakult paistab meri.
2128.de: Large multicoloured stones in the foreground, a spruce on the right. Two thatched-roof houses in the distance, the sea visible from the left.

2129.dm: kõrgus: 89.0 cm; laius: 76.0 cm; kõrgus: 98.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 85.5 cm (raamiga)
2129.d: Eredates toonides rannaäär tuletorni ja majadegrupiga vasakul.
2129.de: Seashore in bright tones with a lighthouse and a group of houses on the left.

2133.d: Paremal rohekassinine meri ja vasakul kõrge kirgastes toonides rand. Taamal tumesinine viirg.
2133.de: On the right a greenish-blue sea and on the left a high shore in glowing tones. A dark blue streak in the distance.

2135.d: Punaste mäenõlvade vahel tee ja maja puudesalus. Taevas rahutud punakates ja kollakates toonides rünkpilved.
2135.de: A road and a house among trees between red mountain slopes. Restless cumulus clouds in reddish and yellowish tones in the sky.

2138.d: Saaremaa perioodil maalitud rannamaastik suurte kirjude kivide ja siniste lilledega esiplaanil. Tagaplaanil veekogu üksikute purjekatega.
2138.de: A coastal landscape painted during the Saaremaa period, with large mottled stones and blue flowers in the foreground. In the background, a body of water with a few sailboats.

2141.d: a) Paljastatud õlaga tumedapäise naise rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Foonil jaapanlanna ja hieroglüüfid.
2141.de: a) Bust portrait of a dark-haired woman with a bared shoulder, in a slight turn to the right. In the background a Japanese woman and hieroglyphs.

2143.d: Paremal lahesopp, vasakul rannaäär kirjude kivide ja roheliste ning valgete taimedega.
2143.de: On the right a bay, on the left a shoreline with mottled stones and green and white plants.

2148.d: Suvine maastik heleda rahutu taevaga. Esiplaanil künklik kallas suure puuga, keskel hele järvepind.

2149.d: Esiplaanil vasakul pooleldi raagus kaheharuline puu. All servas kollastes toonides lehtpuud. Vasakul hallikas veekogu. Taamal kirju sügismaastik.
2149.de: In the foreground on the left a half-bare, two-forked tree. At the bottom edge deciduous trees in yellow tones. On the left a greyish body of water. In the background a colourful autumn landscape.

2150.d: Esiplaanil kolm kollaste lehtedega kaske ja lillakais toonides põõsad. Põõsaste vahel voolab oja. Taamal paistab kasesalu.
2150.de: In the foreground three birches with yellow leaves and bushes in purplish tones. A stream flows between the bushes. A birch grove can be seen in the distance.

2153.d: Lahesopp kahe vasakule merre ulatuva neemega, üksikute põõsagruppidega. Tagaplaanil kogu pildilaiust läbiva lahesopi kaldal tume metsaserv, keskel kaugemal kõrgendikuga. Taevas lillakates toonides rünkpilved.
2153.de: A bay inlet with two headlands extending left into the sea, with isolated groups of bushes. In the background, along the shore of the bay stretching across the whole width of the picture, a dark forest edge, with a rise further in the middle. Sky in lilac-toned cumulus clouds.

2154.d: Lahekäär. Esiplaanil madal klint sellel kasvate taimedega, mis pildivälja keskel ulatub liigendatud neemena paremale merre; ees paremal moodustub väike lahesopp. Tagaplaanil ulatub pika kitsa ribana paremale merre neem. Üleval väga kitsas taevaosa.
2154.de: A bay inlet. In the foreground a low bluff with plants growing on it, which in the centre of the picture field extends as an articulated headland to the right into the sea; on the right in front a small bay inlet is formed. In the background a headland extends as a long, narrow strip to the right into the sea. Above, a very narrow strip of sky.

2156.d: Pildipinna keskel lohkjas tasandik pikliku kujuga järvega esiplaanil künkjaste vallide vahel, üksiku majaga puude vahel tasandiku vasakus servas. Esiplaanil vasakul järvesopp selle taga kasvavate kaskedega. Ees paremal künka jalam, selle taga kaks kaske. Silmapiiril kõrgendikel lehtpuude salud. Taevas pastoossed ebamäärased pilved. Maalil hele värvigamma.
2156.de: In the centre of the picture surface, a hollow plain of elongated shape with a lake, in the foreground between hillocky ridges, with a solitary house among trees on the left edge of the plain. In the foreground on the left, a bay of the lake with birches growing behind it. In front on the right, the foot of a hill, behind it two birches. On the horizon, on elevated ground, groves of deciduous trees. The sky has pastose, indistinct clouds. The painting has a light colour palette.

2157.d: Lohkjas maastik madalate laugjate küngaste vahel, kitsa lookleva jõekesega diagonaalselt maali vasakust alumisest nurgast. Pildivälja keskplaanil paremast äärest vasaku kuldlõikeni kulgev kitsas põõsastesalu kahe heledama lehtpuuga selle lõpus. Tagaplaanil paremas kuldlõikes maja puude vahel. Silmapiiril kogu maali laiuse ulatuses sinetav metsatriip. Taevas lillakasroosad valged rünkpilved. Maali värvigamma - heledates toonides.
2157.de: A hollowed landscape between low, gently sloping hills, with a narrow winding river running diagonally from the lower left corner of the painting. In the middle ground of the picture plane, from the right edge to the left golden section, a narrow grove of bushes with two lighter-coloured deciduous trees at its end. In the background, at the right golden section, a house among trees. On the horizon, across the whole width of the painting, a bluish strip of forest. In the sky, purplish-pink white cumulus clouds. The painting's colour scheme is in light tones.

2158.d: Tüüpiline Lõuna-Eesti järve-, metsatukkade-, nõlvakutega maastik: esiplaanil rohekad, kollakad ja punakad põllulapid, keskplaanil järv, millesse ulatub vasakul, peaaegu pildi servani, maanina; keskel ümarakujuline metsane saar; tagaplaanil uuesti punakad nõlvakud, taevas rahutuis pilvedes.
2158.de: A typical South Estonian landscape with a lake, groves and slopes: in the foreground greenish, yellowish and reddish plots of farmland, in the middle ground a lake, into which, on the left, a spit of land extends almost to the edge of the picture; in the centre a rounded, wooded island; in the background reddish slopes again, the sky with restless clouds.

2159.d: Kitsa, peenejoonelise näoovaali ja suurte siniste silmadega naise poolprofiilis rinnaportree. Keskelt lahkukammitud blondid juuksed kuklal sõlmes. Avaralõikelise, pehmete voltidena langeva kleidi kaeluses oranžikas ja kollane roos.
2159.de: Half-profile bust portrait of a woman with a narrow, finely lined oval face and large blue eyes. Blonde hair parted in the middle and gathered in a knot at the back of the head. In the neckline of a loosely cut dress falling in soft folds, an orangish and yellow rose.

2160.d: Kõrgemate ja madalamate põimuvate küngastega Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Keskplaanis laiem org paari sinise järvesilmaga keskel. Esiplaanil lilleline aas hallide kivide ja kuuskedega vasakul nurgas. Silmapiir väga kõrgel. Silmapiiril keskel ja paremal metsaviirg. Vasakul ülanurgas helesinine taevas pilvedega. Maalitud erksates värvitoonides hõredalt täppivas laadis.
2160.de: A South Estonian landscape with higher and lower intertwining hills. In the middle ground, a wider valley with a couple of blue lake-eyes in the centre. In the foreground, a flowery meadow with grey stones and spruce trees in the left corner. The horizon is very high. At the horizon, centre and right, a strip of forest. In the upper left corner, a light blue sky with clouds. Painted in bright colour tones in a sparsely dabbing manner.

2161.d: Pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega maalitud, suurte värvipindade mõjule põhinev kompositsioon: keskel stiliseeritult antud jõgi, millest paremal üksikud pika puukrooniga tumerohelised puud, vasakul metsast ümbritsetud järvesilm, metsatukk ja kõrgemal lage väli. Silmapiiril ribake merd, ülal hall taevas. Hallikasroheline üldkoloriit.
2161.de: A composition painted with long, precise brushstrokes, based on the effect of large colour surfaces: in the middle a stylised river, to the right of which single dark green trees with tall crowns, on the left a lake eye surrounded by forest, a copse and, higher up, an open field. On the horizon a strip of sea, above a grey sky. Overall grayish-green colour scheme.

2162.d: Esiplaanil laud, mis kaetud oranžikas-punaste lillede ja väänlevate mustritega kollasel foonil. Laual sinise-punasekirju vaas suure puhma lillade ja valgete sirelitega. Foonil erinevate mustritega vaibad või tapeedid. Fooni silmatorkavalt suur ja efektne muster annab tugeva dekoratiivse mõju. Laudlina ja foon maalitud pikkade täppivate pintslilöökidega.

2164.d: Täppivalt maalitud ainisekirju veekogu, keskel türkiissinine looklev joon. Esiplaanil rohelise-lillakirju kallas. Vastaskaldal, roosakaspunase taeva foonil heleroheline aimatav mets.
2164.de: A precisely painted, variegated body of water, in the middle a turquoise-blue winding line. In the foreground a green-purplish variegated shore. On the opposite bank, against a pinkish-red sky background, a faintly discernible light green forest.

2166.de: In the centre a figure of a woman carrying a large stone bound with a ribbon. She wears a dark skirt and a blue blouse decorated with a buckle, her luxuriant hair fluttering. In the foreground dark stones, among which individual ears of grain, and on each edge of the picture a couple of stunted spruces.

6113.d: Vaade tüüpilisele Lõuna-Eesti kuppelmaastikule. Vasakul looklemas kitsas jõgi. Taamal seguneb metsa ja aasa rohelisega viljapõldude kollaseid laike. Helesinises taevas roosakad pilvesagarad. Maalimislaad etüüdilik.
6113.de: View of a typical South Estonian hilly landscape. On the left a narrow river winding. In the distance the green of forest and meadow mixes with yellow patches of grain fields. In the light blue sky pinkish cloud wisps. Painting manner sketch-like.

6114.d: Lillakassiniste lopsakate pilvede all kirevate, roheliste, roosakate, täpiliste nõlvakute vahel sinine järv. Vasakul kaldal püramiidselt tervatipulised põõsad-puud, silmapiiril rohekassinine metsa siluett. Maalitud diagonaalsete, vertikaalsete ühtlaste pikemate pintslitõmmetega.
6114.de: Under lush purplish-blue clouds, between colourful, green, pinkish, spotted slopes, a blue lake. On the left bank pyramidally rounded-topped bushes and trees, on the horizon the greenish-blue silhouette of a forest. Painted with diagonal, vertical, even, longer brushstrokes.

6115.d: Vasakul valgete ning roosakate õitega potilill. Foon heleroheline.
6115.de: On the left a potted flower with white and pinkish blossoms. The background is light green.

6116.d: Esiplaanil kääruline veekogu, tagapool punakais, ookertoonides künklik maastik üksikute põõsa- ja puudegruppidega. Taevas kaetud roosakassinise pilvekahuga. Maalitud värvikalt täppivas laadis, taeva osas pastoosselt.

6117.d: Kireval mustal-punasel taustal kirjus vaasis sirelioksad, kolm lillakat ja kaks valget  õlekobarat heleroheliste lehtede vahel. Maalitud jõulsiselt, pastoosselt.
6117.de: Against a colourful black-and-red background, in a mottled vase, lilac branches, three purplish and two white clusters of blooms among light green leaves. Painted powerfully, pastosely.

6118.d: Rohekas-ookrites toonides künklikus maastikus looklemas kitsas jõelint. Taevas tumesinine, valgete pilveräpsudega. Maastiku vormide dünaamilisust rõhutatud kontuuridega. Koloriit tume. Taeva osa maalitud viltuste (paremalt vasakule) pintslilöökidega.
6118.de: In a hilly landscape in greenish-ochre tones, a narrow ribbon of river winds. The sky is dark blue, with white wisps of cloud. The dynamism of the landscape forms is emphasised with contours. The colouring is dark. The area of sky is painted with slanting brush strokes (from right to left).

6119.d: Paremal osa aheneva suuga rohelisest vaasist, milles harvade lillakasroosade õiekobaratega sirelioksad. Maalitud lühikese nõtke pintslilöögiga. Tumesinine katkev kontuurjoon ümbritseb lehti, hapraid oksi. Taust ookerkollastes, samblarohekais toonides.

6122.d: Esiplaanil rannasopp üksiku kivi ja suure tumeda lodjaga esiplaanil. Taamal paremal kaks palkmaja ja aed, nende taga tumeroheline metsatukk. Metsast vasakul kuldkollane liivane kaldajärsak ja selle kõrval taas mets. Ülal hall taevas. Maalitud hõredalt täppides, aluspappi paista lastes. Mets antud tugevasti siluetti rõhutades.
6122.de: In the foreground a cove with a single rock and a large dark barge in the foreground. Further back on the right two log houses and a garden, behind them a dark green patch of forest. To the left of the forest a golden-yellow sandy bank slope, and beside it forest again. Above, a grey sky. Painted sparsely in dots, letting the underlying cardboard show through. The forest is given with a strongly emphasized silhouette.

6123.d: Esiplaanil neli lillakaspruunide tüvedega ja rõhutatud siluetiga antud rohelise võraga männid. Tagaplaanil vertikaalsete joontega vahendatud metsa siluett. Ülal suured valged pilvekuhilad, mille vahelt paistab jupike erksiniset taevast. Esiplaanil täppimistehnikas rohi ja lilled. Valitsevad rohelised ja valged toonid.
6123.de: In the foreground four pine trees with purplish-brown trunks and an emphasised silhouette, given with green crowns. In the background the silhouette of a forest rendered with vertical lines. Above, large white cloud masses, between which a small patch of bright blue sky can be seen. In the foreground grass and flowers in a stippling technique. Green and white tones predominate.

6144.d: Tumedanahalise poisi portree veerandpöördes vasakule, pea suunatud vaatajale, pilk üles, lõug toetub vasakule käele. Peas roosakaspunane müts, üle õlgade hele rüü. Roheline mustjas taust. Tumedaid kontuure rõhutav laad, foon osaliselt katmata.
6144.de: Portrait of a dark-skinned boy in a quarter-turn to the left, head turned toward the viewer, gaze upward, chin resting on the left hand. On the head a pinkish-red cap, over the shoulders a light robe. Green-blackish background. A manner emphasizing dark contours, the background partly uncovered.

6151.d: Pildi sügavusse suubuv erkroheline niit kollaste lilledega esiplaanil. Ees kaks tumedatüvelist, habraste rippuvate okste ja kollaste lehtedega suurt puud. Tagapool on aimata valgesse ja
6151.de: A bright green meadow with yellow flowers receding into the depth of the picture, in the foreground. In front two large trees with dark trunks, fragile hanging branches and yellow leaves. Behind, one can discern white and

6152.d: Esiplaanil pildi allservas lilleniit, mis keskplaanis läheb üle kollaseks väljaks ja tagapool esialgu madalamateks lillakateks küngasteks ning silmapiiril kõrgeteks sinetavateks mäeharjadeks. Ülal helesinine, valgete ja kollaste pilvedega ühtlaselt kaetud taevas.
6152.de: In the foreground at the bottom edge of the picture a flower meadow, which in the middle ground turns into a yellow field and further back initially into lower purplish hills and on the horizon into high bluish mountain ridges. Above a light blue sky, evenly covered with white and yellow clouds.

6158.d: Esiplaanils üle pildi pinna vasakult paremale kiviaeda meenutav piire põõsastega. Selle taga, keset muru üks suur ümara krooniga ja üks väike roosades õites mandlipuu. Nende taga kergelt mäkke tõusev maastik, väikeste puudega roheluse keskel.
6158.de: In the foreground, running across the picture surface from left to right, a fence resembling a stone wall with bushes. Behind it, in the middle of the lawn, one large round-crowned and one small almond tree in pink blossom. Behind them a landscape rising gently uphill, with small trees amid greenery.

6159.d: Esiplaanil terrakotapunase ja mustaga põõsad. Paremal kaheharuline puutüvi, mille kohal kõrgub üle pildi pinna paindunud puutüvi. Foon antud erekollase, rohelise ja valgega. Taevas sinine. Ülaservas markeeritud puude lehestik.
6159.de: In the foreground shrubs in terracotta-red and black. On the right a two-branched tree trunk, above which a bent tree trunk towers over the surface of the picture. The background is given in bright yellow, green and white. The sky is blue. Foliage of trees marked along the upper edge.

6160.d: Esiplaanil roosakaspunased kivid või põõsad. Nende kõrval paremal kaheharuline murdunud puu, mille taga üle terve pildi pinna paindunud roosa puutüvi. Foonil sügavsinine taevas rahutute valgete pilvedega. Ülaservas mustaga markeeritud puude lehestik.
6160.de: In the foreground pinkish-red stones or bushes. Beside them on the right a forked broken tree, behind which a bent pink tree trunk stretches across the whole surface of the picture. In the background a deep blue sky with restless white clouds. At the upper edge foliage of trees marked in black.

6161.d: Esiplaanil mäeveerul üksik jändrik mänd roosades-punastes toonides. Foonil kuni silmapiirini rohekas-sinine meri, mis läheb horisontaalselt keskjoonest pisut allpool üle samakarvaliseks taevaks. Vee ja taeva vahel kaks kollast ja üks sinine triip.
6161.de: In the foreground on a hillside a lone stunted pine in pink-red tones. In the background, up to the horizon, a greenish-blue sea, which passes horizontally, slightly below the middle line, into a sky of the same hue. Between the water and the sky two yellow stripes and one blue stripe.

6166.d: Keskealise, vuntside ja lõuahabemega mehe rinnaportree en face, tumedas pintsakus, valges särgis, roosaka kaelasidemega. Rinnas vasakul pool (vaataja suhtes) kollaseõieline lill. Tume foon, õlgade kohal sinine.
6166.de: A bust portrait of a middle-aged man with moustache and beard, en face, in a dark jacket, white shirt, pinkish necktie. On the left side of the chest (from the viewer's perspective), a flower with yellow blossoms. Dark background, blue above the shoulders.

6168.d: Üle pildi pinna gruppidena valged kasetüved, mis on pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Paremal nurgas teerada.
6168.de: White birch trunks in groups across the surface of the picture, cut off by the upper edge of the picture. A path in the right corner.

6169.d: Esiplaanil kividega kaetud maapind ning madal kivimüür, mille tagant paistab roheline puudesalu. Taamal kõrgub tumeda lumega kaetud mägi.
6169.de: In the foreground, ground covered with stones and a low stone wall, behind which a green grove of trees can be seen. In the distance rises a mountain covered with dark snow.

6171.d: Esiplaanil massiivsed kaljurünkad, tagaplaanil erksinine meri. Silmapiiril mäe siluett.
6171.de: In the foreground massive rocky crags, in the background a bright blue sea. The silhouette of a mountain on the horizon.

6173.d: Esiplaanil lage rohekates ja valkjates toonides väli, taga mets. Taevas kollakas.
6173.de: In the foreground a bare field in greenish and whitish tones, forest behind. The sky is yellowish.

6181.d: Noore naise rinnaportree poolprofiilis paremale. Peas punane peal, sinine kleit seljas. Näol naeratus.
6181.de: Portrait bust of a young woman in three-quarter profile facing right. A red headscarf on her head, wearing a blue dress. A smile on her face.

6183.d: Esiplaanil kiviaed ja puud, millede vahelt paistab pikk õlgkatusega kivimaja.
6183.de: In the foreground a stone wall and trees, between which a long stone house with a thatched roof is visible.

6184.d: Noore pruuninahalise naise nägu otsevaates. Mustad lahtised juuksed, mille peal roosa rätt. Kõrvarõngad ja kaelaehe.
6184.de: Frontal face of a young brown-skinned woman. Black loose hair with a pink kerchief on top. Earrings and a neck ornament.

6186.d: Esiplaanil poolvarjus kaarekujulise värava ava, läbi mille paistavad valged hooned ja tükk sinist taevast. Taevast on näha samuti pildi ülaosas värava kohal.
6186.de: In the foreground, in half-shadow, the opening of an arched gate, through which white buildings and a patch of blue sky can be seen. Sky is also visible in the upper part of the picture, above the gate.

6188.d: Naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Nõel tätoveeringud. Roosa sall ja müts, mille peal veel raske linik, mis alla langedes varjab õlad. Sinine kleit, suured kõrva- ja rinnaehted.
6188.de: Half-figure of a woman seen frontally. Needle tattoos. A pink shawl and cap, over which a heavy cloth also lies, which falls down and covers the shoulders. A blue dress, large earrings and chest ornaments.

6196.d: Valgete pikkade juuste ja habemega vanamehe pea profiilis vasemale. Tume riietus.
6196.de: The head of an old man with long white hair and beard, in profile facing left. Dark clothing.

6202.dm: lehe kõrgus: 53.2 cm; laius: 63.0 cm (vm); kõrgus: 48.3 cm (vm); lehe laius: 66.4 cm
6202.d: Esiplaanil paremal diagonaalselt vasakule suunduv külavahetee, vasakul üksik puu. Keskosas kogu pildi laiust haarav roigastik, mille taga kuusesalu taustal kelpkatusega talumaja. Taevas ao-valguses.
6202.de: In the foreground on the right a village road running diagonally to the left, on the left a single tree. In the middle section a fence of poles spanning the whole width of the picture, behind it a farmhouse with a hipped roof against a background of a spruce grove. The sky in dawn light.

6205.d: Ees keskel põõsastiku vahelt väljuval teel kaks vasakul liikuvat valgesse riietatud inimfiguuri. Põõsaste ja puudelatvade vahelt näha kaugemal allpool laiuvat merd.
6205.de: In the front centre, on a road emerging from between bushes, two human figures dressed in white moving to the left. Between the bushes and treetops, further below, a sea spreading out is visible.

6207.d: Kaugelt eest taha suunduval tänaval esialal üksik looritatud idamaine naisefiguur. Paremat tänavat ääristavad heledat tooni hoonete müürid.
6207.de: On a street receding from front to back, in the foreground a solitary veiled oriental female figure. The right side of the street is lined with walls of light-toned buildings.

6209.d: Ees rohuplats. Üle tagapool oleva põõsastiku näha veekogu ja künklikku vastaskallast.
6209.de: In the foreground, a grassy area. Over the bushes behind it, a body of water and a hilly opposite shore can be seen.

6216.d: Keskealise vurrudega mehe rinnapilt  profiilis vasakule. Sinises kuues ja sinise kaelasidemega.
6216.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with a moustache in profile to the left. In a blue coat with a blue necktie.

6218.d: Beduiinlanna rinnapilt en face. Peas raskest materjalist üle õlgade rippuv linik. Kaelas mitmekordsed rinnale ulatuvad kaelakeed.
6218.de: Bust of a Bedouin woman en face. On her head a heavy cloth hanging over her shoulders. On her neck multiple necklaces reaching down to her chest.

6219.d: Kepile toetuv mustas rõivais hallipäine habemik-rauk (poolfiguur). Taust hall.
6219.de: A bearded grey-haired old man (half-figure) in black clothing, leaning on a cane. Grey background.

6220.d: Esiplaanil lage muru. Tagapool roigasaia taga puude vahel õlgkatusetega majad.
6220.de: In the foreground open grass. Behind, beyond a pole fence, thatched-roof houses among trees.

6221.d: Esiplaanil grupp lehtpuid. Taustaks kaljumägede siluetid.
6221.de: In the foreground a group of deciduous trees. In the background silhouettes of rocky mountains.

6225.d: Esiplaanil muru ja liivane rada, keskel paremal roigastara. Taamal keskel õlgkatusega hooned ja üksikuid puid, hoonete kõrvalt paistab meri.
6225.de: In the foreground grass and a sandy path, in the middle right a pole fence. In the distance in the middle thatched-roof buildings and single trees, the sea is visible beside the buildings.

6227.d: Tumedajuukselise, keskealise naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Punases pluusis.
6227.de: Half-length portrait of a dark-haired, middle-aged woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a red blouse.

6509.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks seisvat naisefiguuri, keskel veekogu, selle taga mets.
6509.de: In the foreground on the left two standing female figures, in the middle a body of water, behind it a forest.

6511.d: Esiplaanil veekogu milles peegeldub taga kaldal asuv lehtpuumets.
6511.de: In the foreground a body of water in which the deciduous forest on the far shore is reflected.

6512.d: Esiplaanil vasakul üksik suur puu. Tagapool puude vahel aed.
6512.de: In the foreground on the left, a single large tree. Behind it, a garden among trees.

6513.d: Esiplaanil värvilisel linal õunad, vasemal õun taldrikul. Tagapool õitsev oks. Taust sinine.
6513.de: In the foreground, apples on a coloured canvas, an apple on a plate on the left. Behind, a flowering branch. Blue background.

6514.d: Keskplaanis kõrge kaldapank, millel paistab maja viilkatus. Panga all kaldale tõmmatud paat. Vasakul meri. Taevas pilvine. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega.
6514.de: In the middle ground a high riverbank on which the gable roof of a house can be seen. Under the bank a boat drawn up onto the shore. On the left the sea. The sky cloudy. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes.

6515.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Teisel pool kaldal heinamaa. Vasakul puudesalu, paremas servas kaks puud. Maalitud rohekas-pruunides toonides.
6515.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the other side of the bank a meadow. On the left a grove of trees, two trees at the right edge. Painted in greenish-brown tones.

6516.d: Ülalvaade katuste rägale. Paremal lehvib taeva foonil "Punase Risti" lipp. Värvigamma hele. Maalitud laiade pintslitõmmetega.
6516.de: View from above of a jumble of roofs. On the right a "Red Cross" flag flutters against the sky. Light colour scheme. Painted with broad brushstrokes.

6520.d: Jalad harkis seisev põlvpükstes noormees otsevaates, paremas tõstetud käes löögivalmis reket. Maalitud visandlikult, värvikalt, alusmaterjal kumab läbi.
6520.de: A young man in knee-breeches standing with legs apart, in frontal view, in his raised right hand a racket ready to strike. Painted sketchily, colourfully, the ground material shining through.

6521.d: Erksates toonides suvine maastik jõekääruga. Esiplaanil ja paremal neli habrast kaske, lilleline kallas. Taamal nõlvak taluga. Rünkpilvine kõrge taevas.
6521.de: A summer landscape in bright tones with a river bend. In the foreground and on the right four delicate birches, a flowery bank. Beyond, a slope with a farmstead. High sky with cumulus clouds.

6524.d: Ümaranäoline seisev figuur lillakassinises laias hõlstis profiilis vasakule. Taustal markeeritud interjöör. Maal värvikas visandlik, aluspind kumab läbi.
6524.de: A round-faced standing figure in a wide purplish-blue robe, in profile to the left. Marked interior in the background. The painting is colourful and sketch-like, the underlying surface shining through.

6617.d: Esiplaanil, kahel pool, sini-rohelised kõrged puud, paremal, puude all viilkatusega hoone otsavaade. Taevas kollane, ülal siniste pilve-laikudega.
6617.de: In the foreground, on both sides, tall blue-green trees, on the right, under the trees, the gable end view of a building with a pitched roof. Sky yellow, with blue cloud patches above.

6618.d: Ees keskel ja paremal algab rohekates toonides neem, mis lõpeb käänuga vasakule. Ees keskel ja vasakul üksikud sinakad kivid. Taamal, neeme tipu lähedal keskel suur kollakas kogu (kivi?). Silmapiiril veekogus erk-sinine viirg. Taevas kollakas-rohekas.
6618.de: In the front middle and right, a greenish-toned headland begins, ending with a bend to the left. In the front middle and left, isolated bluish stones. Further back, near the tip of the headland in the middle, a large yellowish mass (a stone?). On the horizon in the body of water, a bright blue streak. The sky is yellowish-green.

6662.d: Kägarasse tõmbunud magav, valge, üksikute tumedate laikudega koer. Pea pruun, kõrvad lontis. Foon rohekas-beežikasis värvides.
6662.de: A sleeping white dog curled up into a ball, with a few dark spots. Head brown, ears drooping. Background in greenish-beige tones.

6663.d: Tumedal foonil istuv naisakt. Jalad ristatud, ülakeha otsevaates, ettekallutatyd, mõlemad käed maha toetatud. Pea 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
6663.de: Seated female nude on a dark background. Legs crossed, upper body in frontal view, leaning forward, both hands resting on the ground. Head in 3/4 turn to the left.

6686.d: a) Noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale. Satäänid juuksed kammitud kokku pealaele. Foon tumeroheline. b) 3/4 pöördes, seljaga vaataja poole istuv alasti naise figuur. Ülakeha veidi ette painutatud; parem käsi toetub vasakule reiele. Juuksed kinnitatud kuklal suure musta seosega.
6686.de: a) Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned to the right. Satiny hair combed up onto the crown. Background dark green. b) Seen from a 3/4 angle, a seated nude female figure with her back to the viewer. The upper body slightly bent forward; the right hand rests on the left thigh. The hair is fastened at the nape with a large black bow.

6762.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 35.2 cm; laius: 48.4 cm; kõrgus: 36.5 cm; kujutise laius: 47.1 cm
6762.d: Metsamaastik kahe vees asuva vähipüüdjaga, kel kahvad käes, taga paremal oja kaldal naine koeraga. Taamal mets.
6762.de: Forest landscape with two crayfish catchers standing in the water holding nets, in the background on the right a woman with a dog on the bank of a stream. In the distance a forest.

6794.d: Vaskblondide juustega, näoga vaataja poole pööratud neiu rinnaportree. Keha pööratud paremale, siniste silmade vaade vasakule. Seljas laia valge kraega tumesinine kleit. Foon rohekashall.
6794.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with ash-blonde hair, face turned towards the viewer. Body turned to the right, gaze of the blue eyes to the left. Wearing a dark blue dress with a wide white collar. Background greenish grey.

6817.d: Suvesombune vaade pargiteede lahknemiskohta. Kummalgi pool teed roosaõielised puud rohelistes, nupuliste nurkadega kastides. Tagapool vasakul lilledega ääristatud muruplats, puud-põõsad. Silmapiiril nõlvakul lossi siluett. Paremal rohelised puukroonid. Maal pastelselt hele, läbi sinaka vine nähtud.
6817.de: A summer, overcast view of a fork in park paths. On either side of the path, trees with pink blossoms in green boxes with knobbed corners. Further back on the left, a lawn bordered with flowers, trees and bushes. On the horizon on a slope, the silhouette of a castle. On the right, green tree crowns. The painting pastel-light, seen through a bluish haze.

6886.d: Hallikas, udutaolises üldtoonis, pehmete kontuuridega lumine tänavavaade peaaegu kogu kompositsioonipinda katvate õrnlillade, -kollakate ja -rohekate majafassaadidega tagaplaanil. Keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kuubikujuline kahekorruseline rohekas maja, esiplaanil paremal äärel ühekorruseline lillakas-rohekas puumaja.
6886.de: In a greyish, misty overall tone, a snowy street view with soft contours, with pale purple, pale yellowish and pale greenish house façades covering almost the entire compositional surface in the background. In the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a cube-shaped two-storey greenish house, in the foreground on the right edge a one-storey purplish-greenish wooden house.

6897.d: Lillakasroosa ehapunas taeva taustal kaks võitlevat ratsanikku: vasakpoolne mustal hobusel raudrüüs, tõstetud mõõk käes. Parempoolne pruunil hobusel viskevalmis odaga eestlasest sõdalane külgvaates. Maalitud jõuliselt, tumedaid kontuurjooni rõhutades.
6897.de: Against the backdrop of a lilac-pink sunset sky, two fighting horsemen: the left one on a black horse in armour, a raised sword in hand. The right one on a brown horse, an Estonian warrior in side view with a spear ready to throw. Painted forcefully, emphasising dark contour lines.

6928.d: Kastanpruunide lokkis juustega tütarlapse pea poolpöördes vasakule. Pruunid mandlilõikelised silmad, teravalt väljajoonistuv korrapärane suu, hea jume. Seljas roheline jakk või kleit, millel oranž krae. Foon peamiselt sinistes ja lillakashallides toonides.
6928.de: The head of a girl with chestnut-brown curly hair in half-turn to the left. Brown almond-shaped eyes, a sharply outlined regular mouth, good complexion. Wearing a green jacket or dress with an orange collar. Background mainly in blue and purplish-grey tones.

6929.d: Esiplaanil paremal männid. Neist vasakul põõsas ning vasakult alumisest nurgast paremale kulgev metsavahetee. Teest vasakul, foonil segamets. Puude vahelt paistab hallikassinine taevas. Valdavad on mitmesugused rohelised toonid, maalitud põõsaste ja puude võra osas pastoosselt.
6929.de: In the foreground on the right, pine trees. To their left a bush and a forest track running from the lower left corner to the right. To the left of the track, in the background, mixed forest. Between the trees, a greyish-blue sky is visible. Various shades of green predominate, the foliage of the bushes and trees painted pastosely.

6942.d: Esiplaanil paadi nina punase purjega. Vasakul ehmunud näoga mehe poolfiguur. Paremal stiliseeritud laine valges vahus näha naise figuur pikkade blondide juustega.
6942.de: In the foreground the bow of a boat with a red sail. On the left the half-figure of a man with a startled face. On the right in the white foam of a stylised wave the figure of a woman with long blonde hair is visible.

7098.d: Esiplaanil lopsakas rohi, paremal mitmetes värvides puid-põõsaid. Vasakul madal talumaja, mille tagant paistab kaevukook. Pintslitõmme lai, laineline.
7098.de: In the foreground lush grass, on the right trees and bushes in various colours. On the left a low farmhouse, behind which a well-sweep is visible. The brushstroke is broad, wavy.

7114.d: Paremal eest taha suunduv veekogu, mille vasakul kaldal hoone puudega, paremal kivimüür, selle taga puid.
7114.de: On the right a body of water running from front to back, on the left bank of which a building with trees, on the right a stone wall, behind it trees.

7178.d: Esiplaanil aia taga maja nurk (vasakul), keskel tee, taamal puud.
7178.de: In the foreground behind a fence the corner of a house (on the left), in the middle a path, trees in the distance.

7179.d: Esiplaanil tara ääres kaks kurniviskavat ja kaks puhkavat poissi. Vasakult taha suunduv latt-tara.
7179.de: In the foreground, by a fence, two boys turning somersaults and two boys resting. A lath fence running back from the left.

7180.d: Murul vasemal selgvaates Kalevipoeg - valges vöötatud särgis - ja Sorts paremal vägikaigast vedamas.
7180.de: On the grass on the left, in clear view, Kalevipoeg - in a white striped shirt - and Sorts on the right, pulling a tug-of-war pole.

7277.d: Lumivalgete juuste ning täishabeme ja vurrudega vana mehe pea, otsevaates. Juuksed kammitud vasakule lahku. Alumised silmalaud tugevalt kottis. Foon sinine.
7277.de: Head of an old man with snow-white hair and a full beard and moustache, frontal view. Hair combed parted to the left. Lower eyelids heavily baggy. Background blue.

7278.d: Alläärest, keskelt kaob loogeldes pildisügavikku, männimetsa tee. Metsa kohal laik taevast, üksiku laotuse sinasse hajuva pilveribaga.
7278.de: From the bottom edge, in the middle, a road through a pine forest winds away into the depth of the picture. A patch of sky above the forest, with a cloud streak dissolving into the blue of the lone expanse.

7279.d: Vee piiril taeva taustal astuv Kalevipoeg selgvaates, lauakoorem vasakul õlal, kirjatud tupes mõõk vööl. Paremal jändriku männi latv, silmapiiril metsaviirg. Maal dekoratiivselt värvikas, figuuri ümbritseb pruun kontuurjoon.
7279.de: At the water's edge against the sky Kalevipoeg striding, seen frontally, a load of boards on his left shoulder, an ornamented sword in its sheath at his belt. On the right the crown of a gnarled pine, a strip of forest on the horizon. The painting decoratively colourful, the figure surrounded by a brown contour line.

7280.d: Metsaveerel istuv Kalevipoeg külgvaates vasakule, ristatud käed põlvedel. Paremal, tema selja taga lähenemas hulk sõjamehi kilpide ja mõõkadega. Taamal maastik veekoguga, rünkpilvine taevas. Maal erksavärviline, kujundid ümbritsetud peene tumeda kontuurjoonega.
7280.de: Kalevipoeg sitting at the edge of a forest, in side view facing left, arms crossed on his knees. On the right, behind him, a host of warriors with shields and swords approaching. In the distance a landscape with a body of water, a sky with cumulus clouds. The painting is brightly coloured, the figures outlined with a fine dark contour line.

7281.d: Vasakul seisev Kalevipoeg otsevaates, jalad harkis, langetatud mõõk paremas käes. Tema taga vana kandlemängija, juuksed tuules ja rida seisvaid sõdalasi, piigid püsti. Taamal muistne linnus.
7281.de: Kalevipoeg standing on the left in a frontal view, legs apart, lowered sword in his right hand. Behind him an old kannel player, hair in the wind, and a row of standing warriors, spears upright. In the distance an ancient stronghold.

7282.d: Rannal istuva muistse eestlase /Kalevipoeg/ 3/4 figuur külgvaates vasakule. Mees kätest-jalust köidetud jämeda ketiga kalju külge. Pea rinnal, käed toetuvad taha, jalad ette sirutatud. Taga vasakul tema kohale kummarduva alasti naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Taustaks kivine mererand.
7282.de: 3/4 figure of an ancient Estonian sitting on the shore /Kalevipoeg/, in side view facing left. The man bound hand and foot with a thick chain to a cliff. Head on chest, arms resting behind, legs stretched forward. Behind on the left, the half-figure of a naked woman bending over him, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Background a rocky sea coast.

7283.d: Kolm otsesuunas sõitvat täispurjedes viikingite laeva tähistaeva foonil. Laevadel seisvad sõdalased. Purjedel ornament. Maal sinakas koloriidis, kujundid tugeva kontuurjoonega piiritletud.
7283.de: Three fully-sailed Viking ships sailing straight ahead against a starry sky background. Warriors standing on the ships. Ornament on the sails. The painting in bluish tones, the shapes delineated with a strong contour line.

7284.d: Lagendikul grupp mände, tüvedel päikeselaigud. Puude varjud maapinnal. Tüvede taga helesinine taevas, kaugem metsaviirg. Maalil erksad sinised-rohelised toonid.
7284.de: A group of pines in a clearing, sunspots on the trunks. Shadows of the trees on the ground. Behind the trunks, a light blue sky, a distant strip of forest. The painting is in bright blue-green tones.

7285.d: Sopiliste kallastega veekogu ääres esiplaanil vasakul kolm, paremal kaks pikavarrelist punase kobaraõisikuga taime. Silmapiiril kahvatu kuu, peegeldus vees. Maal sinakais toonides täppivalt, paralleelsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
7285.de: By the shore of a body of water with indented banks, in the foreground on the left three, on the right two long-stemmed plants with red clustered inflorescences. On the horizon, a pale moon, reflected in the water. The painting is executed in bluish tones, dabbed with parallel brushstrokes.

7444.d: Üks püsti ja teine kummargil naine mere ääres jalgupidi vees pesu loputamas. Lillas, oranžis ja rohekas toonis.
7444.de: One woman standing and another bent over, rinsing laundry by the sea with their feet in the water. In purple, orange and greenish tones.

7463.d: Üle pildipinna grupp sügisesi kolletavaid kaski, ülaservaga ladvad ära lõigatud. Maapind ees kolletav, läbi puude paistab sinetav taevas.
7463.de: Across the picture plane a group of autumnal yellowing birches, their crowns cut off at the upper edge. The ground in front is yellowing, and a bluish sky is visible through the trees.

7465.d: Valge, pika täishabemega ning vuntsidega vana mehe portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla, silmalaud kuldraamidega prillide taga langetatud. Valgus langeb vasakult.
7465.de: Portrait of an old man with a white, long full beard and moustache. His head is bowed forward and down, his eyelids lowered behind gold-framed spectacles. The light falls from the left.

7466.d: Ookerkollasel foonil punases pluusis ja kübaras keskealise naise põlvportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Vasaku käega hoiab süles rohelist rätti, parem käsi põlvel. Maalitud ühtlaste, laiemate pinstlilöökidega.
7466.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged woman in a red blouse and hat against an ochre-yellow background, in a quarter-turn to the left. With her left hand she holds a green scarf on her lap, her right hand rests on her knee. Painted with even, broader brush strokes.

7467.dm: kõrgus: 31.4 cm (km); laius: 35.0 cm (lm); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (lm); laius: 23.0 cm (km)
7467.d: Hallipäise, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega vana naise portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla; laud langetatud. Näo veidi kandiline joon rõhutatud valge kraega. Koloriit tume.
7467.de: Portrait of an old woman with grey hair parted in the middle. Head bowed forward and down; gaze lowered. The slightly angular line of the face is emphasized by a white collar. Dark colouring.

7468.d: Samblarohelistes toonides täppivalt maalitud kaldapealne, vasakul käharad puudepuhmad, paremal pruunikas nõlvak. Esiplaanil vesi peegelduva kaldarohelusega.
7468.de: A moss-green-toned, dabbed painting of a waterside, on the left curly clumps of trees, on the right a brownish slope. In the foreground water with reflecting green of the bank.

7557.d: Esiplaanil olevate puutüvede vahelt paistab punase kivikatusega, valgete seintega kabel roheliste lehtpuude taustal.
7557.de: Through the tree trunks in the foreground a chapel with a red tiled roof and white walls is visible against a background of green deciduous trees.

7558.d: Ees rohuribal keskel ringis tantsivate naiste figuurid. Neist vasemal kännul istuv mees kannelt mängimas, tema ees poolalasti mees nooleotsaga. Seljataga kolm poolalasti meest vibudega. Tantsijaist paremal kaks odadega, kolm vibuga meest ja rahvarõivas neiu. Tema kõrval meesfiguur, käsi ümber neiu piha.
7558.de: In front, on a strip of grass, figures of women dancing in a circle in the middle. To their left, a man sitting on a stump playing a kannel, in front of him a half-naked man with an arrowhead. Behind him three half-naked men with bows. To the right of the dancers, two men with spears, three with bows, and a maiden in folk costume. Beside her, a male figure with an arm around the maiden's waist.

7560.d: Vasakul koerteajaja nelja koeraga. Keskel ratsanik pasunat puhumas. Paremal kolm jahimeest lastud põdraga. Nende taga järv marjakobarais pihlakas ja kasetüved. Taamal vasakul kirik, keskel lossivaremed.
7560.de: On the left a dog handler with four dogs. In the centre a horseman blowing a horn. On the right three hunters with a shot elk. Behind them a lake, a rowan tree with clusters of berries and birch trunks. In the distance on the left a church, in the middle castle ruins.

7561.d: Mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis, pöördes vasakule. Helehall juus, kollakad vurrud. Käed põlvedel, vasakus käes sinine raamat. Tume ülikond, valge püstkraega, roheline lips.
7561.de: Half-figure of a man in a seated position, turned to the left. Light grey hair, yellowish moustache. Hands on his knees, a blue book in his left hand. Dark suit, white stand-up collar, green tie.

7562.d: Istuva vanema naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Parem käsi toetatud lauale. Pruunid juuksed, sinine valge kirjaga pluus, tume seelik, õlgadel roheline rätik. Tugevasti toonitatud kontuur. Parema õla taga sinine pind, foon rohekas.
7562.de: Half-figure of a seated older woman in profile to the left. Right hand resting on a table. Brown hair, blue blouse with white lettering, dark skirt, green shawl on the shoulders. Strongly toned contour. Blue surface behind the right shoulder, background greenish.

7563.d: Heledas, pehmes viltkübaras mehe rinnaportree, kerges pöördes paremale. Nägu kujult piklik, silmad lähestikku asetsevad, kergelt pungis; ninajoon peen; suu väike. Seljas hall kuub ja sviiter. Taust hele.
7563.de: Bust portrait of a man in a light, soft felt hat, in a slight turn to the right. Face elongated in shape, eyes set close together, slightly bulging; nose line thin; mouth small. Wearing a grey coat and a sweater. Background light.

7564.d: Pildi allosas kaks madalat taluhoonet nende ümber kasvavate puude-põõsastega. 2/3 maalipinnast võtab enda alla sinine, valgete pilvekaharatega taevas.
7564.de: In the lower part of the picture two low farm buildings with trees and bushes growing around them. 2/3 of the painting's surface is taken up by a blue sky with fluffy white clouds.

7566.d: Jämedate puutüvede vahel kolm alasti mehefiguuri. Keskmisel, esiplaanil oleval mehel käes õlakõrgusele tõstetud kepp. Tema juures, paremal valgepruuni laiguline koer. Figuurid tahtlikult teostatud disproportsionaalsetena; kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud. Maastiku juures kasutatud stiliseerivat laadi. Värvikiht õhuke.
7566.de: Three nude male figures among thick tree trunks. The middle man, in the foreground, holds a stick raised to shoulder height. Next to him, on the right, a white-brown spotted dog. The figures are deliberately rendered disproportionate; contours slightly emphasised. A stylising manner is used for the landscape. Thin paint layer.

7619.d: 1/3 tööst lageda välja all. Silmapiiril metsad. 2/3 pilvine taevas.
7619.de: 1/3 of the work is open field below. Forests on the horizon. 2/3 cloudy sky.

7620.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa keskel tiik, selle taga vasakul puudesalu, paremal lahesopp purjekatega, silmapiiril rannaviirg. Osaliselt pilvine taevas.
7620.de: In the foreground a pond in the middle of a meadow, behind it on the left a grove, on the right a bay inlet with sailboats, on the horizon a coastline. Partly cloudy sky.

7672.d: Natüürmort torukübara, jalutuskepi, kinnaste ja valge salliga.
7672.de: Still life with a top hat, a walking stick, gloves and a white scarf.

7702.d: Suured lillad kivid rohekas-sinise taeva taustal.
7702.de: Large purple stones against a greenish-blue sky background.

7733.d: Ees paekivipõrand, paremal akna all nurgas puukapp. Ülal rida portreid. Keskel trepp balustraadiga vasakul. Vasakul seljaga vastu trepi käsipuud kapp, selle juures tool ja pikas kleidis naise figuur.
7733.de: In front, a limestone floor, on the right under the window in the corner a wooden cabinet. Above, a row of portraits. In the middle a staircase with a balustrade on the left. On the left, with its back to the staircase handrail, a cabinet, next to it a chair and the figure of a woman in a long dress.

7801.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu peegelsile merepind. Horisondil rannaäär. 3/4 tööst rünkpilvedega taeva all.
7801.de: In the foreground an almost mirror-smooth sea surface. Coastline on the horizon. 3/4 of the work under a sky with cumulus clouds.

7809.d: Esiplaanil looklev lumine tee. Taga lumine mets.
7809.de: In the foreground a winding snowy road. Behind it a snowy forest.

7811.d: Ees keskel ja paremal veekogu. Vasakul madal kivine kallas. Vastaskaldal järsuseinalised kaljud.
7811.de: In front, in the middle and on the right, a body of water. On the left a low stony shore. On the opposite shore steep-walled cliffs.

7866.d: Vaade Tallinna Toomkiriku kooriruumi vappidega seinale.
7866.de: View of the wall with coats of arms in the choir of Tallinn Cathedral.

7914.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud kallastega veekogu. Tagapool vasakul madal, rohtunud lehtpuutukkadega kallas.
7914.de: In the foreground a body of water with overgrown banks. Further back on the left a low bank overgrown with clumps of deciduous trees.

8246.d: Esiplaanil üksikud kased ristlevate teeradade ääres. Eemal vasemal üksik hoone, pearemal mets lattaiaga. Kauguses ebamäärane figuur.
8246.de: In the foreground isolated birches beside crossing paths. In the distance on the left a single building, on the right a forest with a plank fence. A vague figure in the distance.

8247.d: Vasakul jõekaldal asetsev väike palkehitis, mille kohal kalda veerel seisev mehefiguur punases särgis, õngeritv käes. Käänuna paremale suunduva jõe vasakul kaldal rida madalaid taluhooneid puusalu ja pilvedega taeva taustal.
8247.de: On the left riverbank a small log building, above which, standing at the water's edge, a male figure in a red shirt, a fishing rod in hand. On the left bank of the river, which curves to the right, a row of low farm buildings against a background of a birch grove and clouded sky.

8250.d: Ees madalate mättaliste kallaste vahel taha paremale suunduv jõgi kalamehega parempoolsel kaldal. Taga paremal okaspuumetsaga kaetud järsunõlvaline mägi, vasakul puisniit.
8250.de: In front, between low tussocky banks, a river running back to the right, with a fisherman on the right-hand bank. Behind at right a steep-sloped mountain covered with coniferous forest, at left a wooded meadow.

8251.d: Esiplaanil jõgi paadiga ja üksikud puutüved, taamal mets onniga. Metsa vahelt, pildi keskel, langeb loojunud päikese punakat valgust.
8251.de: In the foreground a river with a boat and single tree trunks, in the distance a forest with a hut. Through the trees, in the centre of the picture, falls the reddish light of the setting sun.

8257.d: Esiplaanil keskel veekogu (jõgi), mida vasakult ja paremalt piiravad kaldad. Vasakul kaldal üksikud madalad pajud, paremal õlgkatusega maja ja lehtpuude salu. Veel lootsik üksiku inimkoguga. Taustaks ehapunas taevas.
8257.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a body of water (a river) bordered on the left and right by banks. On the left bank isolated low willows, on the right a straw-roofed house and a grove of deciduous trees. Also a boat with a lone group of people. Background of a sky glowing red at sunset.

8272.d: Esiplaanil künkal suur, lumega kaetud puu. Taamal mets. Üle maastiku kaardub hämar taevas. Paremal pool taevas lind lendamas.
8272.de: In the foreground on a hillock a large, snow-covered tree. In the background a forest. A dim sky arches over the landscape. On the right side of the sky a bird flying.

8274.d: Vasakul pildi sügavusesse suunduv jõgi. Selle paremal kaldal tee, mida mööda sõidab hobune vankriga. Tagapool majad ja õitsvad puud.
8274.de: On the left a river receding into the depth of the picture. On its right bank a road along which a horse is drawing a cart. Behind, houses and blossoming trees.

8275.d: Keskel valge, verandade ja rõdudega maja, mida kroonib kuuetahuline torn. Maja taga on aimata tumedates toonides antud pargipuid ja-põõsaid. Esiplaanil liivatatud teed, puupink, viimasest paremal muruplats lillepeenraga. Vasakult langev päikesevalgus valgustab torni ja katuseviilu.
8275.de: In the centre, a white house with verandas and balconies, crowned by a hexagonal tower. Behind the house, park trees and bushes are suggested in dark tones. In the foreground, sanded paths, a wooden bench, and to the right of the latter a lawn with a flower bed. Sunlight falling from the left illuminates the tower and the gable roof.

8278.d: Laual kaks roosakat roosi, taga kuldrandiga tass.
8278.de: Two pinkish roses on the table, behind them a cup with a gilded rim.

8303.dm: kõrgus: 36.2 cm (km); laius: 31.2 cm (lm   ); laius: 29.3 cm (km   ); kõrgus: 39.2 cm (lm   )
8303.d: Kolmnurgale ülesehitatud kahefiguuriline kompositsioonigrupp, esiplaanil naise kuju. Pead pöörates üleõla paremale. Sinisel foonil kaheksa tähte.
8303.de: A two-figure composition group built on a triangle, in the foreground the figure of a woman. Turning her head over her shoulder to the right. Eight stars on a blue background.

8304.d: Tiik, paremal laugjalt tõusva kõrge kaldapealsega. Taamal puude allee. Koloriit hele, valdav roheline toon.
8304.de: A pond, on the right a high bank rising gently. An avenue of trees in the distance. Colouring light, predominant tone green.

8305.dm: kõrgus: 36.3 cm (lm); laius: 36.3 cm (lm   ); laius: 25.9 cm (lm  ); kõrgus: 25.9 cm (lm)

8345.dm: lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm; lehe laius: 23.3 cm
8345.d: Ees kätega seljataga olevale aiale toetuv naise alasti täisfiguur en face. Pea kallutatud vasemale õlale. Taga kaskedega ääreistatud rohumaa.
8345.de: In the foreground a full-length nude female figure, en face, leaning with her hands on a fence behind her. Head tilted towards the left shoulder. Behind, a meadow bordered with birches.

8466.d: Tumeroheline nõlvak, siluetselt lahendatud puudega heleda taeva foonil. Esiplaanil paremal kolm, vasakul üks rohtu sööv lammas.
8466.de: A dark green slope with trees rendered in silhouette against a light sky. In the foreground, three sheep grazing on the right and one on the left.

8475.d: Kaks tiigrit profiilis vasakule metsa taustal.
8475.de: Two tigers in profile facing left against a forest background.

8483.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm alastifiguuri, keskmine selgvaates kiviheiteasendis. Keskplaanil veekogu, millel luigeparv. Tagaplaanil mets.
8483.de: In the foreground on the right three nude figures, the middle one seen frontally in the pose of throwing a stone. In the middle ground a body of water with a flock of swans. In the background forest.

8489.d: Ees järvekallas puudega. Keskel järv. Vastaskaldal hooneid.
8489.de: In the front a lake shore with trees. In the middle a lake. Buildings on the opposite shore.

8523.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm; laius: 51.4 cm (tervik, lm.   )
8523.d: Lagedal, lumisel väljakul kahes reas, eest taha suunduvad ostjate-müüjate read.
8523.de: On an open, snowy square in two rows, rows of buyers and sellers extending from front to back.

8531.d: Varakevadine maastik. Siin-seal lumelaike. Järve kaldal, vasakul pildiserval, väike maja ja lumine heinasaad. Tagaplaanil metsatukk.
8531.de: Early spring landscape. Patches of snow here and there. On the shore of a lake, on the left edge of the picture, a small house and a snowy haystack. A clump of forest in the background.

8551.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides maapind, mis keskel läheb järsult üle roheliseks. Vasakule jääb heinaküün. Ülal diagonaalselt taevariba. Värv kantud lõuendile laiade pintslilüketega, horisontaalselt.
8551.de: In the foreground ground in brown tones, which in the middle changes abruptly to green. On the left is a hay barn. Above, a diagonal strip of sky. The paint is applied to the canvas in broad, horizontal brushstrokes.

8564.d: Vaade talvisele turuplatsile. Esiplaanil keskel heinu sööv must hobune heinaveovankriga. Tagapool hulk hobuseid vankritega, inimeste grupid nende ümber. Taamal keskel kahekorruseline hoone, paremal torniga ja väiksemad majad. Taevas ja maa sulavad ühtlaseks helehall-valkjaks pinnaks, lumel üksikuid sinakad ja pruunid varjud. Maalitud siledalt, maapind veidi pastoossemalt.
8564.de: View of a winter market square. In the foreground centre a black horse eating hay, with a hay cart. Further back a number of horses with carts, groups of people around them. In the distance in the centre a two-storey building, on the right one with a tower and smaller houses. The sky and ground merge into a uniform light grey-whitish surface, with occasional bluish and brown shadows on the snow. Painted smoothly, the ground somewhat more pastose.

8568.d: Laugjas, lumine mäenõlv, kolme, sinakaid varje heitva puuga. Tagaplaanil paremal üksik inimfiguur.
8568.de: A gently sloping, snowy mountainside, with three trees casting bluish shadows. In the background on the right a solitary human figure.

8569.d: Niidetud viljapõld, keskel kaks rida rõuke. Silmapiiril sinerdab metsaviirg.
8569.de: A mown grain field, in the middle two rows of stooks. On the horizon, a strip of forest shows blue.

8570.d: Suvises, päikesepaistelises maastikus heledas rõivastuses noormees kurni mängimas. Keha hoovõtul ettekummardunud, käed kepiga heitevalmilt õlajoonele tõstetud. Tagaplaanil paistab puudevahelt veekogu. Koloriit hele.
8570.de: In a summer, sunlit landscape a young man in light-coloured clothing playing kurni (a throwing game). Body bent forward on the run-up, arms raised to shoulder level with a stick ready to throw. In the background a body of water is visible through the trees. Bright colouring.
